name: Feature-Guided Diffusion for Inverse Rendering
aliases: Feature-Guided Diffusion for Non-Differentiable Inverse Rendering
definition: A method combining a diffusion-based inverse prediction with CMA-ES optimization to solve non-differentiable inverse rendering problems.
summary: Feature-Guided Diffusion for Inverse Rendering is a black-box optimization framework that uses dense visual features to guide diffusion-based inverse prediction and CMA-ES evolution, avoiding single-number loss bottlenecks in non-differentiable inverse rendering.
